title: Get started with filestamp
text: stamp_file() writes header top one file. small R script header: Stamp default template: header inserted top, R’s # comment style, code left untouched . Pass action = "dryrun" see header without changing file. result prints header go file written: action = "backup" copies file <name>.bck stamping, always original: filestamp never re-stamps file already header, running twice safe.
code: script <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines(c("add <- function(x, y) {", "  x + y", "}"), script) stamp_file(script, author = "Jane Doe") cat(readLines(script), sep = "\n") #> # Copyright (c) Acme Corp 2026 #> # Author: Jane Doe #> # License: All rights reserved. #> # Last updated: 2026-07-18 06:02:57 #>  #> add <- function(x, y) { #>   x + y #> } preview <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines("y <- 2", preview) stamp_file(preview, template = "mit", action = "dryrun") safe <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines("z <- 3", safe) stamp_file(safe, action = "backup", author = "Jane Doe") file.exists(paste0(safe, ".bck")) #> [1] TRUE

title: Get started with filestamp
text: Pass action = "dryrun" see header without changing file. result prints header go file written:
code: preview <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines("y <- 2", preview) stamp_file(preview, template = "mit", action = "dryrun")

text: action = "backup" copies file <name>.bck stamping, always original: filestamp never re-stamps file already header, running twice safe.
code: safe <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines("z <- 3", safe) stamp_file(safe, action = "backup", author = "Jane Doe") file.exists(paste0(safe, ".bck")) #> [1] TRUE

title: Get started with filestamp
text: stamp_dir() stamps every file finds. Use pattern match certain files recursive = TRUE descend subdirectories.  result records happened file: config.json file reported skipped: JSON comment syntax, filestamp leaves untouched instead writing invalid header. core promise: filestamp corrupt file know comment. See vignette("language-support") detection works.
code: project <- file.path(tempdir(), "project") dir.create(file.path(project, "R"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE) writeLines("f <- function() 1", file.path(project, "R", "app.R")) writeLines("def g(): pass",     file.path(project, "helpers.py")) writeLines('{"name": "demo"}',  file.path(project, "config.json"))  result <- stamp_dir(project, author = "Jane Doe", recursive = TRUE) #> Warning: Skipping '/tmp/Rtmpu6Sbew/project/config.json': unrecognized file type. #> ℹ No language with a known comment syntax is registered for this extension. data.frame(   file   = basename(vapply(result$results, `[[`, "", "file")),   status = vapply(result$results, `[[`, "", "status") ) #>          file  status #> 1 config.json skipped #> 2  helpers.py success #> 3       app.R success

title: Get started with filestamp
text: vignette("licenses--templates") covers built-license templates, custom templates, variables. vignette("language-support") covers languages filestamp knows add . vignette("maintaining-headers") covers updating copyright years authors files already stamped.

title: Language support
text: detect_language() maps file’s extension language definition. definition carries comment markers filestamp uses formats header.  filestamp ships definitions many languages: template produces different header depending file. Python file gets triple-quoted block, C++ file gets /* */ block:
code: length(languages()) #> [1] 38 py <- tempfile(fileext = ".py") writeLines("def f(): pass", py) stamp_file(py, template = "mit", author = "Jane Doe") cat(head(readLines(py), 4), sep = "\n") #> """ #> MIT License #>  #> Copyright (c) Acme Corp 2026 cpp <- tempfile(fileext = ".cpp") writeLines("int main() {}", cpp) stamp_file(cpp, template = "mit", author = "Jane Doe") cat(head(readLines(cpp), 4), sep = "\n") #> /* #> MIT License #>  #> Copyright (c) Acme Corp 2026

title: Language support
text: extension recognized, detect_language() returns NULL filestamp skips file rather guessing. keeps writing broken header. JSON clearest case: comment syntax , always skipped. extensions shared languages different comment styles, skipped purpose. .m belongs Objective-C, MATLAB, Mathematica; .cls belongs LaTeX, Salesforce Apex, VBA. Guessing wrong corrupt file, filestamp declines: Objective-C still supported unambiguous .mm extension, LaTeX .tex, .sty, .Rnw.

title: Language support
text: Register language filestamp know language_register(). Give name, extensions covers, comment markers. Use comment_multi_start comment_multi_end languages block comments: registered, language available every stamping function rest session. make permanent, put language_register() call project startup, .Rprofile.
code: language_register(   "coffeescript",   extensions = "coffee",   comment_single = "#",   comment_multi_start = "###",   comment_multi_end = "###" )  detect_language("app.coffee")$name #> [1] "coffeescript"

title: Licenses and templates
text: Build template stamp_template_create(). template name, set fields, content render. stamp_template_field() describes one field (default value whether required), stamp_template_content() holds lines header.
code: team_header <- stamp_template_create(   name = "team",   fields = stamp_template_describe(     copyright = stamp_template_field("copyright", "{{company}} {{year}}", required = TRUE),     author    = stamp_template_field("author", "{{user}}", required = TRUE),     team      = stamp_template_field("team", "Engineering", required = FALSE)   ),   content = stamp_template_content(     "Copyright (c) {{copyright}}",     "Author: {{author}}",     "Team: {{team}}"   ) )  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines("x <- 1", f) stamp_file(f, template = team_header, author = "Jane Doe") cat(readLines(f), sep = "\n") #> # Copyright (c) Acme Corp 2026Author: Jane DoeTeam: Engineering #>  #> x <- 1

title: Licenses and templates
text: {...} markers template variables. filestamp fills renders header. built : {year}, {date}, {date_full} come current time; {user} username; {filename} {file_ext} come file stamped. {company} reads global option, can set : Add variable stamp_variables_add(). can fixed value function called file: variable template references resolve left -, typo shows output {typo} rather silently disappearing.
code: stamp_variables_list() #> [1] "company"   "cwd"       "date"      "date_full" "file_ext"  "filename"  #> [7] "user"      "year" options(filestamp.company = "Acme Corp") stamp_variables_add("team", "Data Science")  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines("x <- 1", f) tmpl <- stamp_template_create(   name = "with_team",   content = stamp_template_content("Team: {{team}}", "File: {{filename}}") ) stamp_file(f, template = tmpl) cat(readLines(f), sep = "\n") #> # Team: Data ScienceFile: file1f1651e2051d.R #>  #> x <- 1

title: Maintaining headers
text: Two verbs cover everyday tasks. file header years ago: stamp_bump_year() extends copyright current year, keeping owner start year. stamp_add_author() adds contributor without duplicating anyone already listed: Running either safe: year already current Sam already listed, nothing changes.
code: f <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines(c(   "# Copyright (c) 2020",   "# Author: Jane Doe",   "",   "x <- 1" ), f) stamp_bump_year(f) stamp_add_author(f, "Sam Smith") cat(readLines(f)[1:2], sep = "\n") #> # Copyright (c) 2020-2026 #> # Author: Jane Doe and Sam Smith

title: Maintaining headers
text: anything beyond two, stamp_update() takes named updates directly. value new value, function field’s current value. year_extend() author_add() build functions, can mix plain values single call:
code: g <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") writeLines(c(   "# Copyright (c) 2018",   "# Author: Ada Lovelace",   "# License: GPL-2",   "",   "y <- 2" ), g)  stamp_update(g,   copyright = year_extend(),   author    = author_add("Sam Smith"),   license   = "MIT" ) cat(readLines(g)[1:3], sep = "\n") #> # Copyright (c) 2018-2026 #> # Author: Ada Lovelace and Sam Smith #> # License: MIT

what: Reuse a set of edits across files
title: Maintaining headers
text: stamp_edits() stamp_update() different jobs. stamp_edits() builds reusable bundle changes touches files . stamp_update() applies changes files, whether pass inline bundle. Bundling pays want set edits applied one place. bundle also prints change:
code: edits <- stamp_edits(   copyright = year_extend(),   author    = author_add("Sam Smith") ) edits #>  #> ── Header edits ── #>  #> • copyright: extend the copyright year #> • author: add "Sam Smith"

title: Maintaining headers
text: stamp_update() verbs accept directory well file. Given directory, update every file already header leave rest alone. Use recursive = TRUE include subdirectories.  Every stamped file tree now carries new year author, single call.
code: project <- file.path(tempdir(), "project") dir.create(file.path(project, "R"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE) writeLines(c("# Copyright (c) 2020", "# Author: Jane Doe", "", "a <- 1"),            file.path(project, "R", "a.R")) writeLines(c("# Copyright (c) 2019", "# Author: Ada Lovelace", "", "b <- 2"),            file.path(project, "R", "b.R"))  stamp_update(project, edits, recursive = TRUE)

title: Manage Copyright and Code Headers for R Files
text: can create custom templates using stamp_template_create() function. allows define fields content header.
code: # Create a custom template my_template <- stamp_template_create(   name = "my_custom",   fields = stamp_template_describe(     copyright = stamp_template_field("copyright", "MyCompany 2025", required = TRUE),     author = stamp_template_field("author", "John Doe", required = TRUE)   ),   content = stamp_template_content(     "Copyright (c) {{copyright}}",     "Created by: {{author}}",     "File: {{filename}}"   ) )  # Use the custom template stamp_file("script.R", template = my_template)

title: Manage Copyright and Code Headers for R Files
text: can update existing headers files using stamp_update() function. useful changing copyright years, adding new authors, modifying metadata. [!IMPORTANT] Make sure use stamp_update() function carefully, modify existing files. Always create backups making changes. helper functions may work expected file contain header header expected format. two common tasks direct verbs: anything else, pass named updates stamp_update(). value new value function field’s current value: Bundle set edits stamp_edits() reuse , point update directory apply every stamped file :
code: # Bump the copyright year to the current year stamp_bump_year("old_script.R")  # Add a new author stamp_add_author("collaborative_script.R", "Jane Smith") stamp_update("script.R",   copyright = year_extend(),        # extend the year, keep the owner   author    = author_add("Jane Smith"),   license   = "MIT"                 # or just set a value ) edits <- stamp_edits(   copyright = year_extend(),   author    = author_add("Jane Smith") )  # update every already-stamped file in the project stamp_update("R/", edits, recursive = TRUE)
